notes.title: 9/24/2025: Zoom Improvement (v1.2.1)
notes.content: - While zooming in on a coin, you can now click to flip the coin, and the zoomed image will change accordingly.

notes.title: 9/8/2025: Zoom In! (v1.2.0)
notes.content: - By popular demand, you can now zoom in on each coin (front and back) to see its fine details better. Coins sold by the traveling salesman can also be zoomed in on. Hover over a coin and hold "Z" on your keyboard.

notes.title: 9/3/2025: Hotfix (v1.1.8)
notes.content: - Fixed bug where specials that should be locked at the start of an ascension are not locked.

notes.title: 9/1/2025: Bug Fixes (v1.1.7)
notes.content:
- Fixed bug with seeker "new coins found" statistic.
- Added a button in System to clear cumulative statistics.
- Fixed bug with coin stack comparison height history when 0 total coins have been found.
- Fixed bug with feed not wiping when loading between saves or performing a hard reset.

notes.title: 8/25/2025: Bug Fixes (v1.1.6)
notes.content:
- Fixed UI glitch when you level up while bank or salesman is open.
- Fixed late-game bug where coin rolls can have the wrong types of coins in them.
- Fixed spelling of "Auf Wiedersehen".

notes.title: 8/19/2025: Hotfix (v1.1.5)
notes.content: - Fixed issue with feed keeping far fewer than 200 items.

notes.title: 8/18/2025: Hotfix (v1.1.4)
notes.content:
- More fixes for ascension selections.
- Limited the number of feed entries to 200. (I thought this was happening already.) Hopefully this gets rid of some lag reports I've received.

notes.title: 8/17/2025: Hotfix (v1.1.3)
notes.content: - Fixed problems caused by last fix regarding ability to start certain ascensions.

notes.title: 8/16/2025: Minor Update
notes.content: [p]- Added sound effect for seekers quitting. (Reminder: if you are alt-tabbed doing something else, seeker logic doesn't check for quitting until you come back.)[/p][p]- Fixed bug with starting final two vending ascensions.[/p][p]- Fixed bug in final bank ascension mechanics.[/p][p]- Fixed bug in final coin pusher ascension rewards.[/p][p]- In general, I tried to do a better job prohibiting impossible ascension combinations from being started.[/p]

notes.title: 8/9/2025: Hotfix (v1.1.1)
notes.content:
- Fixed some UI issues within the ascension selections.
- Seeker stats corrected to reflect ascension rewards.

notes.title: Update Notes (v.1.1.0) - Fullscreen and Hotfix
notes.content:
- Changed "Noobie" title to "Newbie".
- Added Fullscreen mode to System tab.
- Added "Save and Exit" button to System tab.
- Added Always-On-Top mode to System tab.
- Fixed bug where Coinmaster button wasn't unlocking upon reaching Level 2.
- Game now saves which toggle you had selected (show have, show don't, show all).
